scenario: No serialisation across restarts per LSER.10.11 — series state cold-starts, and a series lives in working memory only: nothing in this edition carries its state across a restart (LSER.8.3.4). Runtime-only spec point: the engine deliberately doesn't snapshot/restore series state. Compile pins that a series declares with no persistence option to give; cold-start behavior is exercised in the runtimes' end-to-end tests.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Float mutable

series Sensor.state:
    count sliding 10_s

rule trig:
    Sensor t where count(t.state) > 0
->
    log info "x"
